Bono East Region

Bono East

Sitting near the middle of the country, Bono East rewards the traveller who turns a through-route into a proper stop.

Kintampo Waterfalls · Photo: Cdilalo47

Capital

Techiman

Go for

Kintampo, caves, waterfalls and road trips

Good to know

The Kintampo Falls area is one of the region’s best-known stops.
